bestBets.overview: MOMENT IN THE SUN wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. KARSAVINA peaks for this and rise in trip will suit. ANGEL LIKE YOU is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. POWER TO RULE mixes form but best is good enough. ACES TO WIN next best.

raceTips.comment:
KARSAVINA on top in a very thin Class 2 45+ (not sure I've ever seen a 45+ Class 2!). She had her first start on dirt surface of Roebourne last start, survived the kickback and actually ran on into fourth in what would have been heavy air. Can improve signficantly on that run and the extra furlong is only a positive.
MOMENT IN THE SUN meets POWER TO RULE 5.5kg better at teh weight and with a little more ground than last time they met for a 0.5 length defeat. Awkward barrier but Queen of the BTC in Kyra Yuill is on board. 
POWER TO RULE might be worse of at the weights but looks your (only) likely leader and the 4kg claiming apprentice comes off for the all conquering Tash Faithful.
ACES TO WIN racing consistently but is a few lengths of them.

bestBets.overview: GLYDA wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. OLE GRANDE is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. AREDUET has been placed 3 of 5 this time in and must be respected. COUPE DEBURJ hit the line well latest and will be strong late again. BELLE BELLE wouldn't shock if can find best. HARD TO TOP wouldn't shock in weak race.

raceTips.comment:
OLE GRANDE comes out of a C2 and 58+ and drops back into maiden grade for Sue Olive. Beaten 5.5L and 4.5L respectively reads well for a thin maiden where most of his competitors raced against each other 7 days ago at Derby.
COUPE DEBURJ was one of them. Was able to get a nice flow into that race and was attacking the line strongly into second. An extra 100m today will suit. 
GLYDA ran third behind her and that was her best run in quite some time. Austin in the saddle, maps to sit just off the leading brigade the 23 start maiden gets his chance.
AREDUET could land behind his stablemate in running - ignore the big beaten margins at her last two.

bestBets.overview: OCEAN OUTLAW won well latest and can go on with it here. DUST ASIDE broke maiden status 2 back and then was good again latest, keep safe. FIRE THE GUARD strips fitter for first up run and can improve sharply. SANCTIONS strikes a innable race and must be rated highly. ZAHEADLINES looks the blowout hope at odds.

raceTips.comment:
DUST ASIDE won his maiden by 6.5L and then ran into the ghostly grey in Whats the Point where he chased a tearaway leader throughout. B7 is a likely breeze position or box seat. He is going very well - well enough to account for this.
SANCTIONS moves up the order with the 4kg claimer going on board and a kind barrier = surely they go forwrard. Only beaten 3 lengths to our favourite when they last met and gets a kinder set up here today.
OCEAN OUTLAW has to carry an extra 6.5kg for winning in higher grade last start and draws (ironically) the ocean.
FIRE THE GUARD got bumped on jumping last start at his first go on the dirt. Needs to get out cleanly today from the low draw and can be a big improver.

bestBets.overview: MOHEGAN RULER wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. THE TOP BAR off back to back placings must be rated highly. VIVA MARCONI broke maiden status latest and can go on with it here. COONDLE is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. BONDI QUEEN looks suited back to 1300m and can improve sharply.

raceTips.comment:
In the blue corner we have MOHEGAN RULER who had his first start on the dirt 8 days ago when finding the breeze and going down to Whats the Point and his main danger in COONDLE. Draws to lead or take a sit and while he meets Coondle 2kg worse at the weights we get the Spudman in the saddle for a new 4kg apprentice. 
In the red corner we have COONDLE - Tash Faithful jumps in the saddle to replace Jefferson and he looks to get every chance in running as he did last start.
Tash vs Austin. Country racing at its best.
THE TOP BAR has had one poor performance all season - earning a top 3 cheque on every other occasion.
BONDI QUEEN won her maiden by 6lengths (to Viva Marconi who is in this race and won last start) but struggled up in grade 8 days ago.

bestBets.overview: LUCKY LANDING won well latest and can go on with it here. CAPRICORN MAN is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. WHAT'S THE POINT off back to back wins must be rated highly. MAGNABURMA wasn't beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. SUCCESS PLAY wouldn't shock if can find best.

raceTips.comment:
Brave to be going all in on WHAT'S THE POINT - He'll be short enough at the $1.80 at time of writing for a horse stepping up from 1200m to 1780m but his two wins from two starts on the dirt have been electrifying and diverse. Rounding them up down the outside and then cutting back in between runners  was excellent to see. If he is going to get beaten this campaign - it could be here where the extra distance might test his fitness. Expecting this to be a good fitness builder as we head towards Cup Day.
CAPRICORN MAN was responsible for an electric pace last start when charging over to lead. Only run down by 1.5L to LUCKY LANDING in a race that was set up for him to run down that galloper. Will have to do so again 2kg worse at the weights but is probably the strongest over the 1780m.
MAGNABURMA held his own and split those two gallopers last start.

raceTips.comment:
KING'S CALL needs to be forgiven for last start. Beaten by 10 and dragged those behind him a long way in running. That was his first poor run this season, has been given a break of 21 days and his preior form in this grade resulted in two victories. 
CABLE BOY has the Blinkers going back on the old boy, drawing B1, Tash on and his run three starts back in this grade he only just went down to KING CARTEL. Last two runs have been in open grade.
BORDER FORCE went down to GREAT EDITION two starts back by half a length - meets him 5kg better and we havent seen GREAT EDITION for 56 days.

bestBets.overview: PHAROAH SHOW won well latest and can go on with it here. LET'SDEAL mixes form but best is good enough. VEVINSKY won well 2 back and then was good again latest. WHY ME is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. KINGS SICARIO won well latest and must be rated highly. WOLFMAN is knocking on the door and is due for a change of luck. FORTUNE'S LUCK looks the likely leader and will give pleny of cheek again.

raceTips.comment:
PHAROAH SHOW was arrogant last start. He was second up, 1300 rising to 1780m and quite literally beat half the gallopers he meets here today by an extending 4 length margin. I think there was improvement to come out of him on that run. He is going to be awfully hard to beat here and the Broome Cup looms large if he does.
LETS DEAL is on a similiar path and was monstrous first up on the dirt over an unsuitable 1300m three starts back. Since then has gone down to the inform Housewife by 2 lengths and ran on into third behind VEVINSKY last start. He will appreciate the 2070m here and is a legitimate danger to my on top selection.
VEVINSKY...what version do we get today. Two starts back he won by 3.5lengths and it looked like a return of old. Last start he didnt lead, but I still thought he was given every opportunity. Would love to see an aggressive ride to break the field open like they did during his previously successful campaign in '24.
WOLFMAN was beaten into second by 4lengths at the hand of  Pharoah Show last time they met.
